sentence: This project develops an automated assay using extracellular vesicles and vibrational spectroscopy to detect head and neck cancer recurrence earlier.
This project develops lipid nanoparticle mRNA complexes that edit a gene causing seizures in mouse brain tissue, to protect mice from epileptic seizures.
This project builds statistical methods that take geography into account to study human genetic history and the genetic variants that contribute to disease risk.
This project builds free, open-source computational tools in the Galaxy platform to analyze and visualize large, complex cancer research datasets.
This project builds a shared hub that helps cancer researchers with bioinformatics and biostatistics.
This project develops an MRI-based biomarker of astrocyte dysfunction and tests a therapy aimed at astrocytes in neonatal brain injury.
This project tries to find the genetic causes of stillbirth by studying a large group of cases with computational methods.
This project tries to understand the causes of musculoskeletal diseases, which remain poorly understood.
This project brings researchers together to share work on how genetics, model systems and biological mechanisms shape craniofacial health and tissue regeneration.
This project studies how Stabilin receptors in liver cells clear endotoxins from the gut and control inflammation throughout the body.
This project builds a method combining gene editing with single-cell sequencing to run large genetic screens of T cell development in living animals.
This project offers biomarker services, such as mass spectrometry analysis, to study complications of HIV in the brain.
This project studies how a histone demethylase called LSD1 guides heart cell fate and gene control during heart development.
This project tries to find antioxidant biomarkers and DNA variants in keratoconus and builds patient-derived cell models to study how the disease works.
This project builds a curriculum on treating health problems caused by female genital mutilation and tests it in a randomized controlled trial.
This project builds and tests a smartphone app based on a talk therapy to help Veterans with posttraumatic stress disorder and depression function better.
This project makes knock-in mouse models to test how variants in non-coding regulatory regions, such as enhancers, affect gene expression and disease.
This project tests whether a neighborhood engagement program added to a remote physical activity program increases physical activity in older women over one year.
This project builds features and automation for a shared web resource that gathers expert interpretations of cancer variants.
This project tests a stem cell therapy combined with PD-1 blockade to overcome treatment resistance in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.
